result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `TimedRunnable` class in `OrderedScheduler.java`, including the buggy line `taskPendingStats.registerSuccessfulEvent(initNanos, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)`, which passes the raw start timestamp instead of the actual elapsed duration. The fix commit corrects this exact line by wrapping it with `MathUtils.elapsedNanos(initNanos)`. Blame directly traces the buggy line back to this commit which created the file and this logic from scratch.
